text: Joanna and Nate are friends. Joanna writes, revises a family recipe, and got another production company rejection (possibly a film contest entry); she'll keep pushing on. Nate practices for video game tournaments, stressed by tough competitors, and finds comfort in his turtles. Joanna named the stuffed dog Nate gave her Tilly, after her childhood dog in Michigan; she became allergic and had to give that dog up.
